sourceSummary: Sheffield United 2026/27 current first-team selection cross-checked against the official 2026/27 retail personalisation roster and contemporary squad evidence, with latest published Transfermarkt valuations and positional data. For late-window arrivals whose Transfermarkt club field still reflects a previous club, current Sheffield United roster evidence is kept separate from valuation evidence.
